correctness.rationale: The original 2011 theorem gives a necessary-and-sufficient obstruction criterion for fixed-boundary linear bigram reconstruction. Twelve explicit pattern-pair detectors over three symbols yield 247 reachable valid product states. Executing the embedded exact integer verifier establishes the full vector identity \(M^6(M-I)^3\boldsymbol1=\boldsymbol0\) in all 247 coordinates. Matrix commutation gives the recurrence at all later lengths; the first nine initial values determine the quadratic and rational series. An independent exhaustive checker matches all singleton-profile counts through length ten. The proof states quantifiers and uses finite computation as an actual finite matrix certificate, never to extrapolate an infinite claim.

value.rationale: Singleton observation fibers measure exact information recovery rather than just feasible read outcomes. The precise quadratic law, earliest exceptional length and recovery probability show the sharp contrast between an exponentially large ternary source and polynomially many uniquely decodable words, a natural global invariant of 2-gram reconstruction. The explicit integer-vector certificate supplies a meaningful exact evaluation not contained in the prior regularity statement.
